Welcome to L.W. Jenkins Ltd

Welcome to L W Jenkins Ltd. We are fully equipped to work in a range of metals including mild steel, stainless steel and aluminium alloys. We have a reputation for reliability, quality and competitiveness within the sheet metal fabrication industry. Our friendly but professional service has helped build up a large customer base, mainly within the electronics industry, whilst our ability to meet tight delivery times has allowed us to attract new business. We are cost effective, enthusiastic, reliable and professional. Our continual investment in the latest technology keeps us at the forefront of sheetmetal fabrication.

Our most recent acquisition is an Amada laser which is linked to off-line CAD/CAM systems accepting DXF/DWG programs. Programming can be undertaken from drawings, sketches or artwork to suit the customer's needs. The laser produces sophisticated components to any design. We can produce prototypes as well as undertaking small to large batch work. We can do MIG and TIG welding on carbon steels, stainless steels and aluminium).

We have the capability through sub contractors of finishing parts to powder coating, shot blast, epoxy paint, bright zinc / colour passivate, chrome plate or anodising.

Lionel Jenkins started his own sheetmetal business in Bristol in 1976. Dave Heinrich joined in 1996 to help run the company when Lionel went into retirement. The business has thrived and in 2007 Dave and Lionel became partners in L W Jenkins Ltd.

Get in touch today on 07584499229
Our equipment includes the following:-

Cutting

Amada Laser FOM2 3000x1500 - can cut mild steel up to 25mm thick, stainless steel up to 10mm thick and aluminium up to 8mm thick
Safan CNC 2.5m guillotine - can cut mild steel from 0.5mm to 6.35mm thick, stainless steel from 0.5 to 4.5mm thick, aluminium 0.5 to 8.5mm thick

Folding

New January 2015 Amada HG8025 7 Axis 80 ton x 2.5m CNC Brake Press
Amada HFP 20/50 7 Axis 50 ton x 2.0m CNC brake press

Insertion Machine

Haeger 824
Haeger 618 can put in rivet bushes, standoffs, self-clinching studs and fasteners
